subject: Intro → Technical Deep Dive: FinBlock — scheduling, prework, and travel
messages:
From: Paul Kim <paul.k@finblock.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Novak <sasha.novak@finblock.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo scheduled 7/8 — need to shift and change scope

Hi Rishi,

Quick note — our execs just got pulled into a roadshow and our Head of Platform (who was supposed to join the 7/8 intro) will be traveling that week. Given that, we'd prefer to postpone the generic intro and instead do a more technical session (deep dive or scoping workshop) when the engineering leads are available.

Two asks: can we move the meeting out to the following week, and can the format change to a technical deep dive / POC scoping session (we want to discuss integration points and token retention patterns)?

Preferred windows from our side: 7/12 afternoon PT or 7/14 AM PT. If neither works, happy to take a calendar poll. Also request a short prework checklist we can circulate to our engineers so they come prepared.

Thanks — sorry for the last-minute shift.

Paul
Paul Kim
VP, Platform Engineering
FinBlock

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Paul Kim <paul.k@finblock.com>
Cc: Sasha Novak <sasha.novak@finblock.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo scheduled 7/8 — need to shift and change scope

Hi Paul — thanks for the heads up and totally understand. We can absolutely switch the format to a technical deep dive / POC scoping session. Lauren (Solutions Engineering) and Monica (Customer Success) are cc'd so we can line up the right attendees and prework.

Proposed next steps:
- Option A: 7/12, 2:00–3:30 PM PT (engineering + product deep dive)
- Option B: 7/14, 9:00–10:30 AM PT (hands-on scoping session)

I attached an initial agenda (agenda_finblock_v1.docx) and a short prework checklist (prework_checklist.md) — these are drafts, Lauren can adjust. If those windows don't work, I can send a 3-option poll.

Lauren — can you confirm availability for the technical run-through and whether we should include one of our runtime engineers for KV cache/quantization discussion? Monica — any customer success prep items you want included?

I'll hold 7/12 2:00–3:30 PM PT tentatively on my calendar until we confirm.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189

[attachment: prework_checklist.md]

From: Paul Kim <paul.k@finblock.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Novak <sasha.novak@finblock.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo scheduled 7/8 — need to shift and change scope

Thanks Rishi — 7/12 2:00–3:30 PM PT works for most of our team except our infra lead who is on an overseas trip until 7/15. Given that, two follow-ups:

1) Could we split the session into: 60 min technical deep dive (core integration points) + 30 min follow-up with infra team (recording + notes) so their absence isn’t blocking the POC kickoff?
2) Sasha asked if you could share a short SOW draft and any example runbooks that show how Redwood handles prefix/KV cache and quantization decisions.

If you can do the split and provide the SOW + runbook examples, we can confirm 7/12 on our end. If Lauren or an engineer can lead the technical portion and record the infra-specific segment, that would be ideal.

Appreciate the flexibility — will confirm final attendee list by EOD 7/8.

Paul

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Paul Kim <paul.k@finblock.com>
Cc: Sasha Novak <sasha.novak@finblock.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo scheduled 7/8 — need to shift and change scope

Great — thanks for the clarity, Paul. We can do the split format on 7/12: 60 min technical deep dive (recorded) + 30 min follow-up Q&A recorded for your infra team. Calendar invite with recording enabled will go out after Lauren confirms her availability (cc'd).

Attached: updated agenda (agenda_finblock_v1.docx — updated), SOW stub (FinBlock_SOW-draft.pdf), and the prework checklist. Quick prework bullets for engineers:
- Share one sample integration flow (API endpoints + expected throughput)
- List expected peak sequence lengths and typical latency SLOs
- Any compliance concerns for token retention (e.g., retention TTLs, redaction needs)

Lauren — can you also bring an engineer who can speak to KV cache/quantization tradeoffs? If yes, we'll put them down as a required attendee.

Paul — here's the poll link in case you need to adjust times: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finblock-td-poll
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FIN-4392

I'll send the invite once Lauren confirms; otherwise holding 7/12 2:00–3:30 PM PT tentatively.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Rishi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
